annotations.title: IKE and IKZE retirement accounts in Poland (KNF)

description: Use for the IKE and IKZE market: accounts, assets, contributions by institution type and average balance. IKE and IKZE (Polish individual retirement accounts with tax relief) from half-yearly KNF data: number of accounts and assets, split by institution type (insurers, investment funds, brokers, banks, voluntary pension funds), accounts opened, contributions, withdrawals and returns since January, holders by sex and age, average annual contribution as % of the statutory annual limit (December states), and the finwire index finwire_ike_ikze_avg_balance (average balance per account). Amounts in PLN. For the contribution limits themselves use get_legal_limits. Informational data, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past half-yearly states in the summary, default 6.
